description: The legitimate twin: the SAME gauntlet, the SAME standing observed at t=40 with horizon t=50, but the spend is attempted at t=45 -- within the horizon. The standing-spendability gate passes; the chain consumes. This is the contrast half of the demo's Act 1: the impostor (case 08) and the twin traverse identical machinery and diverge only on the gap. A system that only refuses is a brick; the twin proves the gate admits fresh standing.
